title: Add more metadata and customizability to standard "About" page
line: A widget's About page can now show a Donate link and the third-party libraries it bundles, each with its license and website.
explanation: The widget About page only showed the standard KPlugin fields, so a widget had no place to show a donation link or the libraries it bundles with their licenses, which some licenses require. KAboutData already has components and Kirigami's About page has a Donate link, but neither was reachable from widget metadata. KPluginMetaData now reads a Components array (Name, Description, Version, Website, License or LicenseFile) into KAboutComponent, Kirigami's AboutItem lists aboutData.components under "Libraries in use" with license and website buttons, and the widget About page passes those components plus a DonateUrl key.

commits.message:
KPluginMetaData: read bundled third-party components from metadata

Plugins had no way to list the libraries they bundle, so their licenses
could not be shown anywhere. A new Components key is now read into a list
of KAboutComponent, with the license from an identifier or a file.

BUG: 520379

AboutItem: show the components listed in the about data

The about data's components, such as the libraries an application or
plugin bundles, were never shown. They are now listed under "Libraries in
use" with buttons to read their license and open their website.

BUG: 520379

desktoppackage: show bundled components and donation link in widget About page

Widgets could not show the libraries they bundle with their licenses, nor
a donation link, in the standard About page. It now shows the Components
and DonateUrl keys from the widget's metadata.

BUG: 520379

patches.diff:
From 4d18e3cbad8f1b60333368c8d5c9fb1a474bb306 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:02:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] AboutItem: show the components listed in the about data

The about data's components, such as the libraries an application or
plugin bundles, were never shown. They are now listed under "Libraries in
use" with buttons to read their license and open their website.

BUG: 520379
---
 src/controls/AboutItem.qml | 50 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 49 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/controls/AboutItem.qml b/src/controls/AboutItem.qml
index 511e4512..f49d840f 100644
--- a/src/controls/AboutItem.qml
+++ b/src/controls/AboutItem.qml
@@ -61,6 +61,7 @@ Item {
                   "spdx" : "GPL-2.0"
               }
           ],
+          "components" : [],
           "copyrightStatement" : "© 2010-2018 Plasma Development Team",
           "desktopFileName" : "org.kde.kirigamiapp"
        }
@@ -344,7 +345,54 @@ Item {
 
         KF.FormGroup {
             title: qsTr("Libraries in use")
-            visible: aboutItem.showLibraries
+            visible: aboutItem.showLibraries || repComponents.count > 0
+            Repeater {
+                id: repComponents
+                model: aboutItem.aboutData.components
+                delegate: KF.FormEntry {
+                    id: componentDelegate
+
+                    // type: KAboutComponent | { name, description?, version?, webAddress?, licenses? }
+                    required property var modelData
+
+                    readonly property bool hasLicense: typeof(modelData.licenses) !== "undefined" && (modelData.licenses.text ?? "").length > 0
+
+                    contentItem: QQC2.Label {
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        text: (componentDelegate.modelData.name + " " + (componentDelegate.modelData.version ?? "")).trim()
+                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
+                    }
+
+                    subtitle: componentDelegate.modelData.description ?? ""
+
+                    trailingItems: [
+                        QQC2.ToolButton {
+                            visible: componentDelegate.hasLicense
+                            icon.name: "license-symbolic"
+                            text: qsTr("Show license for %1").arg(componentDelegate.modelData.name)
+                            display: QQC2.ToolButton.IconOnly
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.delay: Platform.Units.toolTipDelay
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.visible: hovered
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.text: visible ? componentDelegate.modelData.licenses.name : ""
+                            onClicked: {
+                                licenseSheet.text = componentDelegate.modelData.licenses.text.replace(/([^\r\n])\r?\n(?!\s)/g, "$1 ")
+                                licenseSheet.title = componentDelegate.modelData.name
+                                licenseSheet.open()
+                            }
+                        },
+                        QQC2.ToolButton {
+                            visible: (componentDelegate.modelData.webAddress ?? "").length > 0
+                            icon.name: "globe"
+                            text: qsTr("Visit %1's website").arg(componentDelegate.modelData.name)
+                            display: QQC2.ToolButton.IconOnly
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.delay: Platform.Units.toolTipDelay
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.visible: hovered
+                            QQC2.ToolTip.text: componentDelegate.modelData.webAddress ?? ""
+                            onClicked: Qt.openUrlExternally(componentDelegate.modelData.webAddress)
+                        }
+                    ]
+                }
+            }
             Repeater {
                 model: aboutItem.showLibraries ? Platform.Settings.information : null
                 delegate: KF.FormEntry {
-- 
2.53.0

From 1a89c7d1f5e78b2021a97cb4cebc14a98b2b1a47 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:02:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: show bundled components and donation link in
 widget About page

Widgets could not show the libraries they bundle with their licenses, nor
a donation link, in the standard About page. It now shows the Components
and DonateUrl keys from the widget's metadata.

BUG: 520379
---
 desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AboutPlugin.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AboutPlugin.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AboutPlugin.qml
index e0fa5a62be..a1d10f7258 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AboutPlugin.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AboutPlugin.qml
@@ -37,6 +37,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
         }
 
         showLibraries: false
+        donateUrl: page.metaData.rawData.KPlugin?.DonateUrl ?? ""
         aboutData: {
             "displayName": page.metaData.name,
             "productName": "",
@@ -55,6 +56,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                 "text": page.metaData.licenseText,
                 "spdx": page.metaData.license,
             }] : [],
+            "components": page.metaData.components,
             "copyrightStatement": page.metaData.copyrightText,
             "desktopFileName": "",
         }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Test widget with DonateUrl and three Components in its metadata: the About page ignores them
Same widget: Donate link and a "Libraries in use" list with license and website buttons
noVNC's license read from the LicenseFile bundled in the widget package
QtKeychain's license from its SPDX identifier (BSD-3-Clause)

review.text: This fixes it in the right layers. KPluginMetaData::components() reads Components into KAboutComponent the same way Authors builds KAboutPerson, and Kirigami's AboutItem now renders aboutData.components, which also helps apps. The widget page only passes them through. The screenshots show the Donate link and Libraries list, with licenses from both an SPDX id and a bundled file. Maintainers may ask for DonateUrl to be a KPluginMetaData accessor rather than a rawData lookup in QML, and the three MRs need landing in order (kcoreaddons, kirigami, plasma-desktop).
